name: Wickerfolk
aliases: figures made of wicker woven with flowers
description: Wickerfolk are spindly figures of wicker woven with flowers that dance and claim victims for the House of Duskmourn.

timeline.quote: Our detectors weren't keyed for wickerfolk.

timeline.quote: There were seven in all, four of them occupied by humanoid rats

timeline.quote: The rat-person was gone, leaving a woven wicker doll behind, lifeless and limp.

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the Wanderer charges, cuts open Nashi's cage and is killed by branches bursting from her ribs.
timeline.quote: Blood began to blossom on the front of her tabard before tree branches burst out of her ribcage

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko throws a ghost-filled shard at the lead wickerfolk and another that encloses Nashi and carries him out of the cage.
timeline.quote: The second struck Nashi, enveloping him as it flew onward, through the bars of the cage.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up

timeline.summary: The Wanderer frees the other captive nezumi, who say wickerfolk fear fire.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer dodged them easily, moving to cut the other occupied cages open.

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer uses Winter's lighter to ignite grass and drive the wickerfolk into the woods.
timeline.quote: A tiny flame shot out, and the grass lit up, burning like a beacon.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The reader dances with wickerfolk until wicker wraps around their bones.
timeline.quote: By the time you feel the wicker wrapping around your bones, it's far too late.
